title: Loop and uLoop Assembly Protocol
author: Bernardo Pollak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yxnfxme
materials: Odd and even level assemblies use different formulations due to specific requirements of the restriction enzymes used. For odd levels (BsaI or BsaI-HFv2), 10x T4 DNA ligase buffer is used. For even levels (SapI), 10x Cutsmart buffer is used mixed with 10x T4 DNA ligase buffer in a 1:1 ratio. For BSA (bovine serum albumin), check stock concentration. NEB 'molecular biology grade BSA' comes at 20 mg/mL, depreciated NEB purified BSA comes at 10 mg/mL. Prepare 20 µl of 1 mg/mL diluted BSA in water solution. Thaw buffers at RT, then place on ice. IMPORTANT: Do not use BsaI-HF, that enzyme will NOT work with this reaction. Use either BsaI or BsaI-HFv2. Use aliquoted volumes of T4 Buffer since ATP and DTT will degrade over short amounts of time (less than a month) affecting the efficiency of the reaction. If low efficiency is seen, use double the restriction enzyme volumes.

Pick 2 white colonies for each construction and grow in 10 mL of LB + respective antibiotic and perform plasmid purification. Validate assembly by means of restriction digest. Suggested enzymes: ThermoFischer XbaI and PstI FastDigest enzymes. If higher concentrations are required, increase inoculation volume and perform Midi prep as directed by manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Calculate and prepare DNA concentrations
steps.instruction: Determine the required concentrations for donor and receiver plasmids to achieve specific molarities.

substeps.instruction: Calculate donor part concentration (ng/µL) as: plasmid length / 100 (to yield 15 fmol/µL).
Calculate receiver plasmid concentration (ng/µL) as: plasmid length / 200 (to yield 7.5 fmol/µL).

steps.title: Assemble DNA mix
steps.instruction: Combine the DNA components in a PCR tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of each donor part at 15 fmol/µL.
Add 1 µL of receiver plasmid at 7.5 fmol/µL.
Add water up to a total volume of 5 µL (note: assemblies from L1 and above do not require adjustment as 5 plasmids are used).

steps.title: Prepare 2x Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the appropriate master mix based on the assembly level, including an extra reaction to account for pipetting errors.

substeps.instruction: For Odd level BsaI-Ligase 2x master mix, combine: 3 µL HPLC H2O, 1 µL 10X T4 DNA ligase buffer, 0.5 µL 1 mg/mL Diluted BSA, 0.25 µL 400 U/µL T4 DNA ligase, and 0.25 µL 10 U/µL BsaI.
For Even level SapI-Ligase 2x master mix, combine: 1.5 µL HPLC H2O, 1 µL 10X Cutsmart buffer, 1 µL 100 mM DTT, 1 µL 10 mM ATP, 0.25 µL 400 u/µL T4 DNA ligase, and 0.25 µL 10 U/µL SapI.
Mix by pipetting to distribute enzymes from the bottom, then pipette from the top for accurate dispensing.

steps.title: Combine DNA and Master Mix
steps.instruction: Mix the DNA components with the enzyme mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the corresponding reaction master mix to the 5 µL of DNA mix.

steps.title: Transform and Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Transform the assembly product into competent cells and recover.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 µL of the reaction to transform chemically competent cells.
Recover cells in SOC for 1 hour at 37 ºC in a shaking incubator.

steps.title: Plate and Select
steps.instruction: Plate the recovered cells on selective media.

substeps.instruction: Prepare plates with respective antibiotics supplemented with 50 ug/mL of X-GAL and 1 mM IPTG.
